title: Fuzheng Jiedu Tongluo Granule mitigates blood-brain barrier disruption after ischemic stroke via inhibiting transcytosis in cerebral vascular endothelial cells.
authors: Liu, Siyu; Li, Chang; She, Yong; Wan, Haitong; He, Yu
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过Wnt/β-catenin/Mfsd2a/Cav-1轴抑制内皮细胞转胞吞保护血脑屏障，核心为脑血管疾病机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，仅含分子对接但非针对TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The increased transcytosis in endothelial cells (EC) represents a significant secondary pathological event that results in BBB disruption following cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI). The Wnt/beta-catenin pathway has been recognized for its vital role in maintaining BBB integrity, but its impact on transcytosis in brain ECs following CIRI remains unclear. Prior research has demonstrated that Fuzheng Jiedu Tongluo Granule (FZJDTL) was effective in treating post-stroke damage. Nonetheless, the precise mechanism underlying FZJDTL's protective effects on the BBB remains ambiguous and necessitates further exploration. PURPOSE: This research sought to examine how FZJDTL protected the BBB in the aftermath of CIRI, and to clarify that the key mechanism pathway was via Wnt/ beta-catenin/Mfsd2a/Cav-1 axis regulating endothelium transcytosis and maintaining BBB integrity. METHODS: The chemical profile of FZJDTL was carried out through LC-MS. The potential protective effect mechanisms of FZJDTL on CIRI were first elucidated by an integrated approach combining transcriptomics analysis and network pharmacology. Molecular docking analysis was performed to investigate the interactions between the active ingredients of FZJDTL and the proteins Wnt3a, beta-catenin, Mfsd2a, and Cav-1. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) was further employed to validate the binding capacity. In vivo experiments were conducted using a MCAO/R rat model to assess the effects of FZJDTL on CIRI. TTC and HE staining were conducted to assess pathological injury. The function of BBB was evaluated employing Evans blue (EB) penetration, and the number of Cav-1 mediated transcytosis vesicles in murine cerebral capillary ECs was quantified by TEM. Immunofluorescent staining was employed to observe Cav-1 expression in brain. The mRNA and protein expression levels of Wnt3a, beta-catenin, Mfsd2a, Cav-1, and claudin-5 were determined by RT-qPCR and Western Blotting analysis. Furthermore, a mouse brain microvascular endothelial cell (bEnd.3) model subjected to oxygen-glucose deprivation/ reoxygenation (OGD/R) was established in the in vitro experiment. The efficacy of FZJDTL for providing protection was assessed through the evaluation of cell viability using the CCK8 assay, measuring BBB integrity through transepithelial electrical resistance (TEER) value and sodium fluorescein (SF) leakage, and analyzing claudin-5 protein expression. RESULTS: Eighty-four components were identified in FZJDTL. Comprehensive network pharmacology and transcriptomics analysis hinted that FZJDTL alleviated CIRI by inhibiting transcytosis vesicles via triggering the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. Given that activation of the vesicle inhibitory protein Mfsd2a downregulates the expression of the vesicle transport protein Cav-1 via the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway, it was prompted the hypothesis that FZJDTL inhibited transcytosis through Wnt/beta-catenin modulation, thereby alleviating CIRI. The molecular docking analysis indicated that lithospermic acid B, luteolin, adenosine, hydroxysafflor yellow A, paeonol, and formononetin may serve as potential key active ingredients interacting with the proteins Wnt3a, beta-catenin, Mfsd2a, and Cav-1. The SPR results confirmed that Wnt3a bound to lithospermic acid B, paeonol, formonoetin, luteolin, adenosine, and hydroxysafflor yellow A. In the in vivo experiments, treatment with FZJDTL dose-dependently reduced neurological function score and cerebral infarct volume, it also ameliorated cerebral histopathological injury. TEM results revealed that FZJDTL inhibited the increase of transcytosis vesicles in MCAO/R rats. The therapeutic effect of FZJDTL on post-CIRI by mitigating BBB dysfunction as demonstrated by a reduction in macromolecule (EB and albumin) leakage in MCAO/R rats, as well as proved by increased TEER value and reduced macromolecule SF leakage after OGD/R in bEend.3 cells. FZJDTL alleviated MCAO/R- or OGD/R-induced BBB damage via upregulation of the Wnt/beta-catenin/Mfsd2a signaling pathway, which subsequently suppressed downstream Cav-1 expression, reduced Cav-1-mediated transcytosis vesicles, and increased expression of claudin-5, a tight junction protein critical to the structural integrity of the BBB. CONCLUSIONS: FZJDTL alleviated CIRI by modulating the Wnt/beta-catenin signal pathway to promote Mfsd2a expression, inhibit the expression of Cav-1, further impeding vascular endothelial transcytosis, and ultimately protecting the function of the BBB.
abstract_zh: 背景：内皮细胞（EC）中增加的转胞吞作用（transcytosis）是脑缺血再灌注损伤（CIRI）后血脑屏障（BBB）破坏的重要继发性病理事件。Wnt/β-catenin通路已被认识到在维持BBB完整性中发挥关键作用，但其对CIRI后脑EC转胞吞作用的影响仍不清楚。先前研究表明，扶正解毒通络颗粒（FZJDTL）在治疗卒中后损伤方面有效。然而，FZJDTL对BBB保护作用的确切机制仍不明确，需进一步探索。目的：本研究旨在探讨FZJDTL如何在CIRI后保护BBB，并阐明其关键机制通路是通过Wnt/β-catenin/Mfsd2a/Cav-1轴调节内皮转胞吞作用并维持BBB完整性。方法：通过LC-MS对FZJDTL进行化学成分分析。通过整合转录组学分析和网络药理学的方法，初步阐明FZJDTL对CIRI的潜在保护机制。采用分子对接分析研究FZJDTL活性成分与蛋白Wnt3a、β-catenin、Mfsd2a和Cav-1之间的相互作用。进一步采用表面等离子体共振（SPR）验证结合能力。体内实验使用MCAO/R大鼠模型评估FZJDTL对CIRI的影响。采用TTC和HE染色评估病理损伤。通过伊文思蓝（EB）渗透性评估BBB功能，并通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）定量小鼠脑毛细血管EC中Cav-1介导的转胞吞囊泡数量。采用免疫荧光染色观察脑中Cav-1表达。通过RT-qPCR和Western Blotting分析测定Wnt3a、β-catenin、Mfsd2a、Cav-1和claudin-5的mRNA和蛋白表达水平。此外，在体外实验中建立了小鼠脑微血管内皮细胞（bEnd.3）氧糖剥夺/复氧（OGD/R）模型。通过CCK8法评估细胞活力、通过跨内皮电阻（TEER）值和荧光素钠（SF）渗漏测量BBB完整性，并分析claudin-5蛋白表达，来评估FZJDTL的保护效果。结果：在FZJDTL中鉴定出84种成分。综合网络药理学和转录组学分析提示，FZJDTL通过触发Wnt/β-catenin信号通路抑制转胞吞囊泡，从而缓解CIRI。鉴于囊泡抑制蛋白Mfsd2a的激活通过Wnt/β-catenin信号通路下调囊泡转运蛋白Cav-1的表达，这提示了FZJDTL通过Wnt/β-catenin调节抑制转胞吞作用，从而缓解CIRI的假设。分子对接分析表明，紫草酸B、木犀草素、腺苷、羟基红花黄色素A、丹皮酚和芒柄花素可能是与蛋白Wnt3a、β-catenin、Mfsd2a和Cav-1相互作用的潜在关键活性成分。SPR结果证实Wnt3a与紫草酸B、丹皮酚、芒柄花素、木犀草素、腺苷和羟基红花黄色素A结合。在体内实验中，FZJDTL治疗剂量依赖性地降低神经功能评分和脑梗死体积，并改善脑组织病理损伤。TEM结果显示，FZJDTL抑制了MCAO/R大鼠中转胞吞囊泡的增加。FZJDTL通过减少MCAO/R大鼠中高分子量物质（EB和白蛋白）渗漏来缓解CIRI后BBB功能障碍，并通过增加OGD/R后bEnd.3细胞中TEER值和减少高分子量SF渗漏得到证实。FZJDTL通过上调Wnt/β-catenin/Mfsd2a信号通路缓解MCAO/R或OGD/R诱导的BBB损伤，随后抑制下游Cav-1表达，减少Cav-1介导的转胞吞囊泡，并增加claudin-5（对BBB结构完整性至关重要的紧密连接蛋白）的表达。结论：FZJDTL通过调节Wnt/β-catenin信号通路促进Mfsd2a表达，抑制Cav-1表达，进一步阻碍血管内皮转胞吞作用，最终保护BBB功能，从而缓解CIRI。
